acceptanceCriteria: A required PR check runs `make cross-vet` or an equivalent windows/amd64 and linux/arm64 vet of the root module and interop/cem01-go.
The added CI time is measured and recorded.
body: The go-product job in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs `go vet ./...` only for its native linux target ("Full static, formatting and build checks"). `make cross-vet` (Makefile:105, windows/amd64 and linux/arm64) runs only inside `make gate`. A windows-only compile failure in cmd/corvint tests (V1-0399) therefore passed PR CI and merged, and first failed the 1.0.0-rc.1 release gate on 2026-09-27, costing a gate rerun. Adding `make cross-vet` to the go-product checks changes .github and needs the owner's ci-control-plane consent.
title: CI go-product does not run cross-vet, so a cross-OS compile gap first surfaces at the release gate
